pages.title: Spatial Clustering Analysis
pages.raw_text: This lecture introduces spatial clustering analysis in GIS. Students should understand how clusters, hot spots, and spatial patterns can be detected from geographic data.

pages.title: Hot Spot Detection
pages.raw_text: Hot spot analysis identifies statistically significant spatial concentrations. It is often discussed together with spatial autocorrelation, Getis-Ord statistics, and interpretation of mapped results.

pages.title: Classroom Case
pages.raw_text: A city analyst wants to detect where incidents are concentrated and explain whether the observed pattern is random, clustered, or dispersed.
